local function geniter(f, s, c)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local mt = getmetatable(f)

		if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
			f, s, c = mt.__iter(f)
		elseif type(f) == "table" then
			f, s, c = next, f, nil
		end
	end

	return function()
		local r = table.pack(f(s, c))

		if r[1] == nil then
			return false
		end

		c = r[1]

		return true, table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
	end
end

			local v5322 = ({
				new = function()
					local t338 = {
						selectedTrollAudio = nil,
						selectedLoudAudio = nil,
						trollLoop = false,
						loudLoop = false,
						fastLoop = false,
						DEFAULT_VOLUME = 1,
						LOOP_WAIT_TIME = 1,
						FAST_LOOP_WAIT_TIME = 0.03,
						DEFAULT_LOUD_AUDIO = 6314880174
					}

					local function createSound(p644, p645, p646)
						local DEFAULT_VOLUME = p646 or t338.DEFAULT_VOLUME
						local HumanoidRootPart = p645 or spilled.LocalPlayer10.Character and spilled.LocalPlayer10.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not HumanoidRootPart then
							spilled.lib:Notify({
								Title = "warn",
								Description = "I didn't find it ",
								Type = "Error",
								Duration = 4
							})

							return nil
						end

						local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

						Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(p644)
						Sound.Volume = DEFAULT_VOLUME
						Sound.Parent = HumanoidRootPart

						return Sound
					end
					local function v5328(p647)
						local RE = spilled.ReplicatedStorage5:FindFirstChild("RE")

						if RE then
							local v5330 = RE:FindFirstChild("1Gu1nSound1s")

							if v5330 then
								local ok = pcall(function()
									v5330:FireServer(spilled.Workspace, p647, t338.DEFAULT_VOLUME)
								end)

								if not ok then
									spilled.lib:Notify({
										Title = "warn",
										Description = "error playing audio on server ",
										Type = "Error",
										Duration = 4
									})
								end
							else
								spilled.lib:Notify({
									Title = "warn",
									Description = "sound event not found 404 ",
									Type = "Error",
									Duration = 4
								})
							end
						else
							spilled.lib:Notify({
								Title = "warn",
								Description = ".RE not found 202",
								Type = "Error",
								Duration = 4
							})
						end
					end

					t338.playAudio = function(p648, p649, p650)
						if not p649 then
							spilled.lib:Notify({
								Title = "warn",
								Description = "specific id not found ",
								Type = "Error",
								Duration = 4
							})

							return
						end

						if p650 then
							v5328(p649)
						end

						local v5333 = createSound(p649)

						if v5333 then
							v5333:Play()
							v5333.Ended:Connect(function()
								v5333:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
					t338.playClientSideAudio = function(p651, p652)
						local AudioAllClient = spilled.Workspace:FindFirstChild("Audio all client")

						if not AudioAllClient then
							AudioAllClient = Instance.new("Folder")
							AudioAllClient.Name = "Audio all client"
							AudioAllClient.Parent = spilled.Workspace
						end

						local v5335 = createSound(p652, AudioAllClient)

						if v5335 then
							v5335.Looped = false
							v5335:Play()
							task.spawn(function()
								task.wait(1)

								if v5335 and v5335.Parent then
									v5335:Destroy()
								end
							end)
						end
					end
					t338.startTrollLoop = function(p653)
						if not p653.selectedTrollAudio then
							spilled.lib:Notify({
								Title = "warn",
								Description = "no troll audio selected 207 ",
								Type = "Error",
								Duration = 4

							return
						end

						p653.trollLoop = true
						task.spawn(function()
							while p653.trollLoop do
								p653:playAudio(p653.selectedTrollAudio, true)
								task.wait(p653.LOOP_WAIT_TIME)
							end
						end)
					end
					t338.stopTrollLoop = function(p654)
						p654.trollLoop = false

					t338.startLoudLoop = function(p655)

						p655.loudLoop = true

							while p655.loudLoop do
								p655:playAudio(p655.selectedLoudAudio, true)
								task.wait(p655.LOOP_WAIT_TIME)
							end
						end)
					end
					t338.stopLoudLoop = function(p656)
						p656.loudLoop = false
					end
					t338.startFastLoop = function(p657)
						p657.fastLoop = true
						task.spawn(function()
							while p657.fastLoop do
								v5328(p657.DEFAULT_LOUD_AUDIO)

							end
						end)
					end

					end

					end

		local v6054 = ({
			new = function()
				local t374 = {
					selectedTrollAudio = nil,
					selectedLoudAudio = nil,
					trollLoop = false,
					loudLoop = false,
					fastLoop = false,
					DEFAULT_VOLUME = 1,
					LOOP_WAIT_TIME = 1,
					FAST_LOOP_WAIT_TIME = 0.03,
					DEFAULT_LOUD_AUDIO = 6314880174
				}

				local function createSound(p776, p777, p778)
					local DEFAULT_VOLUME = p778 or t374.DEFAULT_VOLUME
					local HumanoidRootPart = p777 or spilled.LocalPlayer7.Character and spilled.LocalPlayer7.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if not HumanoidRootPart then
						spilled.lib:Notify({
							Title = "warn",
							Description = "I didn't find it ",
							Type = "Error",
							Duration = 4
						})

						return nil
					end

					local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

					Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(p776)
					Sound.Volume = DEFAULT_VOLUME
					Sound.Parent = HumanoidRootPart

					return Sound
				end
				local function v6060(p779)
					local RE = spilled.ReplicatedStorage3:FindFirstChild("RE")

					if RE then
						local v6062 = RE:FindFirstChild("1Gu1nSound1s")

						if v6062 then
							local ok = pcall(function()
								v6062:FireServer(spilled.Workspace, p779, t374.DEFAULT_VOLUME)
							end)

							if not ok then
								spilled.lib:Notify({
									Title = "warn",
									Description = "error playing audio on server ",
									Type = "Error",
									Duration = 4
								})
							end
						else
							spilled.lib:Notify({
								Title = "warn",
								Description = "sound event not found 404 ",
								Type = "Error",
								Duration = 4
							})
						end
					else
						spilled.lib:Notify({
							Title = "warn",
							Description = ".RE not found 202",
							Type = "Error",
							Duration = 4
						})
					end
				end

				t374.playAudio = function(p780, p781, p782)
					if not p781 then
						spilled.lib:Notify({
							Title = "warn",
							Description = "specific id not found ",
							Type = "Error",
							Duration = 4
						})

						return
					end

					if p782 then
						v6060(p781)
					end

					local v6065 = createSound(p781)
